edits.old:
```bash
# Clean build artifacts
mvn clean

# Clean specific directory
mvn clean -DbuildDirectory=out
```
edits.new:
```bash
# Clean build artifacts (deletes the default ${project.build.directory}, usually "target")
mvn clean
```

To clean a *non-standard* build directory, configure it in the POM (there is no generic `-DbuildDirectory=...` CLI switch for `mvn clean`):

```xml
<build>
    <directory>out</directory>
    <plugins>
        <plugin>
            <groupId>org.apache.maven.plugins</groupId>
            <artifactId>maven-clean-plugin</artifactId>
            <configuration>
                <directory>${project.build.directory}</directory>
            </configuration>
        </plugin>
    </plugins>
</build>
```

edits.old:
### Incremental Builds

```bash
# Skip unchanged modules
mvn install -amd

# Use build cache (requires Maven Daemon)
mvnd install
```
edits.new:
### Incremental Builds

```bash
# Build a subset of modules (and optionally their dependencies)
mvn install -pl module-name -am

# Also build modules that depend on the selected module(s)
# (typically used together with -pl)
mvn install -pl module-name -amd

# Use build cache / faster incremental builds (requires Maven Daemon)
mvnd install
```
